sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

N: W
N: W. F. P.
STATUTES
ORDINANCE I OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE MUQARRARIDARS
(CONFERMENT OF PROPRIETARY RIGHTS) ORDINANCE, 1995
1. Short title, extent‑ and commencement.‑‑(1) This
Ordinance may be called the North‑West Frontier Province Muqarraridars
(Conferment of Proprietary Rights) Ordinance, 1995. '
(2)
It shall extend to the whole of the North‑West Frontier Province.
(3)
It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Muqarraridars Conferment of Proprietary Rights Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Definitions

N: W
N: W. F. P.
STATUTES
ORDINANCE I OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE MUQARRARIDARS
(CONFERMENT OF PROPRIETARY RIGHTS) ORDINANCE, 1995
2.
Definitions: ‑(1) In this Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant
in the subject or context,‑‑
(i)
"Government" means the Government of the North‑West Frontier.
(ii)
"Muqarraridar" means any person who holds land owned or administered
by Government and has been entered as Muqarraridar in the Revenue Records
before the commencement of the North‑West Frontier Province Tenancy Act,
1950 (Act XXV of 1950), and includes his successors‑in -interest;
(iii)
"prescribed" means prescribed by rules made under this Ordinance. .
(2)
Words and expressions not specifically defined here shall have the same
meanings as are assigned to them in the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967
(W.P. Act XVII of 1967).

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Muqarraridars Conferment of Proprietary Rights Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Conferment of proprietary rights on muqarraridars

N: W
N: W. F. P.
STATUTES
ORDINANCE I OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE MUQARRARIDARS
(CONFERMENT OF PROPRIETARY RIGHTS) ORDINANCE, 1995
3.
Conferment of proprietary rights on Muqarraridars.‑ Notwithstanding
anything to the contrary contained in any law for the time being in force, any
person entered as Muqarraridar in relation to land owned or administered by
Government shall become full owner thereof on payment of compensation to
Government at such rate, within such period and on such terms and conditions as
may be prescribed.
